name: submit_gate_no_advance_wins_over_unknowns

unknown: Are you legally authorized to work?

spec: 1. `no_advance` true → `["dry-run", "no-advance"]`.

name: submit_gate_not_approved_wins_over_unknowns_and_problems

problems: Phone number could not be verified

spec: 2. `submit` false → `["dry-run", "not-approved"]`.

name: submit_gate_unknown_wins_over_problems_check
spec: 3. any step has a non-empty `unknown` list → `["needs-user", "unknown"]`.

name: submit_gate_step_problem_readback
spec: 4. any step has a non-empty `problems` list, or any field in any step whose `ok` is not true → `["needs-user", "readback"]`.

name: submit_gate_field_without_ok_is_not_ok
spec: A field with `ok` missing counts as not ok. … any field in any step whose `ok` is not true → `["needs-user", "readback"]`.

name: submit_gate_no_fields_at_all_is_empty
spec: 5. no fields at all across every step → `["needs-user", "empty"]`.

name: submit_gate_inactivity_notice_and_earlier_step_errors_ignored

errors: You will be logged out in 45 seconds due to inactivity

spec: The inactivity notice "You will be logged out in N seconds due to inactivity" (any N, any case) is not a real error, and neither is an empty / whitespace-only string. Errors of earlier steps are ignored (those steps already moved on).

name: submit_gate_page_error_wins_over_consent_ask
spec: 6. the LAST step's `errors` contain a real error → `["needs-user", "page-error"]`.

name: after_submit_done_no_step_bar
args: Thank you for applying! We will be in touch.
spec: "done" when the text contains a thank-you / submitted sentence (case-insensitive) … AND either there is no step bar, or the current step is the last one (n = m) …

name: after_submit_done_with_bar_on_last_step
args: Step 1 of 4. Candidate Profile (Complete Step) Step 4 of 4. Review (Current Step) Your application has been submitted.
spec: "done" when the text contains a thank-you / submitted sentence (case-insensitive) … AND either there is no step bar, or the current step is the last one (n = m) …

name: after_submit_thank_you_on_ordinary_step_is_next
args: Step 2 of 4. Candidate Questions (Current Step) Step 3 of 4. Assessments (Incomplete Step) Thank you for applying
spec: A thank-you sentence on an earlier, ordinary step (e.g. "Step 2 of 4. Candidate Questions (Current Step)") is not "done". … otherwise "next" when there is a step bar and `before` is null, or its current step number is greater than `before`.

name: after_submit_next_with_null_before
args: Step 1 of 4. Candidate Profile (Current Step) Step 2 of 4. Candidate Questions (Incomplete Step)
spec: otherwise "next" when there is a step bar and `before` is null, or its current step number is greater than `before`.

name: after_submit_refused_when_step_does_not_advance
args: Step 1 of 4. Candidate Profile (Complete Step) Step 3 of 4. Assessments (Current Step) Step 4 of 4. Review (Incomplete Step)
spec: otherwise "refused" when there is a step bar whose current step number is equal to or smaller than `before` (the page did not move forward) …

name: after_submit_refused_no_bar_with_error_word
args: We could not save your application. Please check the required fields and try again.
spec: … or when there is no step bar, `before` is a number, and the text contains an error word: "required", "please correct", "please check", "invalid", "error".

name: after_submit_blank_page_pending
spec: otherwise "pending" (blank page, redirect, unrelated text, a login page) — the runner keeps waiting and then looks for the company's receipt e-mail.

name: after_submit_thank_you_for_interest_alone_is_pending
args: Thank you for your interest in Acme. Sign in to your account to continue.
spec: "thank you for your interest" alone is not a thank-you sentence.

name: consent_gate_empty_text_ok
spec: empty / whitespace-only / null text (no consent box) → "ok".

name: consent_gate_privacy_notice_ok
args: We collect and process your personal data for the purposes of this application, as described in our privacy notice.
spec: anything else → "ok": a privacy notice / data-processing consent for this application …

name: consent_gate_interview_terms_ok
args: I acknowledge the interview terms: no AI tools may be used during interviews, no photos or recordings are permitted in interviews, and I agree to a background check.
spec: anything else → "ok": … and the interview terms the candidate accepted on 2026-11-03: no AI tools during interviews, photos or recordings in interviews, a background check.

name: consent_gate_text_messages_beyond_application_ask
args: I agree to receive text messages from Acme about my application and other marketing communications.
spec: "ask" when the text contains wording beyond the application (case-insensitive): … "marketing", … or a consent / agreement to calls, text messages, texts or SMS ("I agree to receive text messages", "consent to SMS").

name: consent_gate_beyond_wording_with_approved_snippet_ok
args: I AGREE to receive   text messages from Acme.
spec: … unless the text also contains one of the `approved` snippets (list of strings or of objects `{"contains": str}`), compared case- and whitespace-insensitively; an empty snippet never matches → then "ok".

name: posting_key_classic_tenant_with_slug
spec: `https://<tenant>.icims.com/jobs/<id>/<anything>` (any path after the id: `/login`, `/job`, `/<slug>/candidate`, any query or fragment) → `"<tenant>.icims.com/jobs/<id>"` with the host lower-cased …

name: posting_key_login_icims_default_rule
spec: `login.icims.com/…` is not a posting: it falls through to the default rule (the URL without its query and fragment).

name: posting_key_posting_with_query_and_uppercase_host
spec: `https://<tenant>.icims.com/jobs/<id>/<anything>` (any path after the id: `/login`, `/job`, `/<slug>/candidate`, any query or fragment) → `"<tenant>.icims.com/jobs/<id>"` with the host lower-cased; `<tenant>` may contain letters, digits, dots and dashes (e.g. `careers-acme`, `uscareers-acme`).
